create_audit_table: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS cleaning_instruction_runs (instruction_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, batch TEXT NOT NULL, book_id INTEGER NOT NULL, data_id INTEGER, action TEXT NOT NULL, execute_status TEXT NOT NULL, executed_at TEXT NOT NULL, verification_status TEXT NOT NULL, error_message TEXT)
count_data_by_book: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM data WHERE book = ?
count_data_by_id: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM data WHERE id = ?
update_book_title: UPDATE books SET title = ? WHERE id = ?
update_data_name: UPDATE data SET name = ? WHERE id = ?
select_book_title: SELECT title FROM books WHERE id = ?
select_data_name: SELECT name FROM data WHERE id = ?
upsert_audit: INSERT INTO cleaning_instruction_runs (instruction_id, batch, book_id, data_id, action, execute_status, executed_at, verification_status, error_message) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?) ON CONFLICT(instruction_id) DO UPDATE SET execute_status = excluded.execute_status, executed_at = excluded.executed_at, verification_status = excluded.verification_status, error_message = excluded.error_message
